scripts.//prebuild: Next resolves @course-prod/core through its exports map, which points at dist/. Building core here — rather than relying on the caller passing `--filter @course-prod/web...` — means a bare `pnpm --filter @course-prod/web build` also works. Railway's Railpack builder emits exactly that command, and without this the build fails with 'Cannot resolve @course-prod/core/db'.
scripts.//postbuild: next build leaves .next/static and public outside the standalone tree, and `next start` refuses to run against a standalone build at all. Copying them in here makes the standalone output self-sufficient, so `pnpm start` works under any builder — Docker or Railway's Railpack — instead of only under the Dockerfile that did these copies itself.
scripts.//start: Launched through server-start.mjs, which pins the bind host in-process. Railway splits startCommand into argv with no shell, so an env prefix like `HOSTNAME=:: node ...` is read as a program name and fails.
